---
name: Rule or tooling defect
about: Report a reproducible standard inconsistency or starter-kit failure
---

## Identity and impact

Standard version/commit, affected rule/file, platform/runtime and practical impact.

## Reproduction

Safe minimal fixture and expected/actual behavior. Redact private paths/data.

## Evidence

Executed checks, exit codes and limitations. Do not attach credentials or user projects without an appropriate private channel.
